name: Native
long_description:
Native is the proactive marketing assistant for businesses, based in San Francisco and Oslo. 

It understands your business, your goals, and what it takes to get there. Then it gets to work. It runs campaigns across your channels, ads, blogs and email, right from your inbox! It tracks your competitors and comes back to you with your next best move. Instead of generating random slop, it tells you what it needs, and then works it into high performant content. Optimising your spend and visibility across channels, improving growth for thousands of companies. 

Your marketing assistant needs no installation, you just text it!
one_liner: A proactive marketing assistant for businesses
